What is Interkont?

Interkont is the technology partner for public-sector transparency. We combine technology, data analytics and artificial intelligence with a highly qualified team so that government entities can monitor their investments and projects with complete clarity.
Our innovation and effectiveness in the service of transparency, endorsed by institutions in Colombia and abroad.
High-value technology solutions specializing in large-scale, transparent tracking of high-impact projects and contracts.
